name: ClearML
tagline: ClearML is an open-source MLOps suite that covers the full machine learning lifecycle from experiment tracking and data management to model deployment and pipeline orchestration. It integrates with popular ML frameworks and provides a self-hosted or cloud-managed control plane for AI teams.
